$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F1: the single source of truth for SpellGame's style values. scripts/tokens-build.mjs generates the token block in index.html (between the tokens:begin/end markers) and src/tokens.rs from this file; the pre-push hook fails if either is out of date. Edit this file, never the generated output. A leaf is an object with $value; its CSS custom property is --<path with dots as dashes> unless $css names it (the original names were kept in Phase A1 so the migration changed zero pixels). Phase A1 tokenised colours only, at their exact pre-migration values; durations arrive in A4 and type in A3.

ui-chrome.$description: v8 F6: reserved INTERFACE accent (letter slots, counts, status). Picture strokes may never use it (scripts/chrome-separation-check).

bg.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F5: Eclipse's dark ramp is neutral near-black (saturation <= 6%, scripts/dark-ramp-check.mjs). #0A0A0B is signed (D4).

controls.$description: The player's Controls colour (Settings > Controls). surface-raised and edge-strong are mixed from it, so one pick tints the menu, setup bar, answer box and Delete. This value is the default. CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F5 (S1): Eclipse's default is a neutral grey, so the default raised panel mixes to #1C1C1F; a picked Controls colour still tints.

icon-stroke.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F8: the icon set's stroke width, in 24 px grid units.

button.$description: The player's Buttons colour (Settings > Buttons): the fill of Check spelling, Done and every primary button. Unset it follows the accent (so the ja/zh accent overrides still apply).

button-ink.$description: Text on a primary button. settings::set_button_color flips it light or dark for the picked fill by contrast ratio.

neutral.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX S1: the theme's own (neutral) controls, first and the default.

violet.$description: Violet is a pick now, not the default. One step off the old default #7a66c2 on purpose: settings::load_prefs reads a stored #7a66c2 as the pre-hotfix DEFAULT and moves it to the neutral one.

surface-raised.$description: The play screen's primary controls (menu, setup bar, answer box, Delete): brighter than surface so they hold up on a black background (Eric, build 288 review).

lift-1.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: the faintest raised fill or divider on any surface. Ink-derived, so it lifts on a dark theme and darkens on a light one (it replaced white overlays that vanished on Daybreak).

lift-2.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a raised fill (keys, cells, chips).

lift-3.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: the strongest raised fill (a typed cell, a pressed key).

control-border.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1/I2: the outline that identifies an unselected chip, toggle or field. At least 3:1 against every surface on every theme; --edge stays the decorative card border.

control-border-on-bg.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX I2: --control-border for a control on the page itself (the glow swatches), from the page's ink so a Background pick keeps it at 3:1. A surface resets it to --control-border.

icon.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: icon and line-art stroke (Spell Picture outlines).

icon-dim.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a line-art stroke not yet traced.

text-on-bg.$description: Text that sits directly on --bg-color (not inside a card). Recomputed at runtime by settings::set_bg_color from the actual WCAG contrast against the chosen background.

text-muted-on-bg.$description: Derived from --ink-on-bg so it stays legible relative to whichever ink was picked. Panel-hosted text keeps the static --ink/--muted.

accent.$description: Per-language override for ja and zh (see $overrides).

accent-on-light.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: the accent as text on a light page (a light Background pick on a dark theme), the same amber Daybreak uses for text.

good-on-light.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

bad-on-light.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

warn-on-light.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

good-on-dark.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

bad-on-dark.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

warn-on-dark.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F1: a verdict colour as text directly on a picked Background (the feedback line), chosen by the page's lightness, not the theme's.

glow.$description: User-settable (settings.rs set_css_var); per-language override for ja and zh.

text-dark.$description: Orb glyph text on a light orb colour (settings::contrasting_text).

text-light.$description: Orb glyph text on a dark orb colour (settings::contrasting_text).

success.$description: Feedback state, GLOBAL across languages and Kid/non-Kid (kids learn one signal).

caution.$description: Feedback state: WARM AMBER, never red or a screen flash (D3).

1.$description: Streak warmth: --glow nudges warmer in pre-designed steps (D5); accent only.

easy.$description: CC-SPELLDOKU v1.3 F3 tier badges: one hue per band, global; all four clear 3:1 on --panel-2.

black.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX: the fade target of a page's gradient (named colours are not allowed in components).

text-on-light.$description: Dark ink settings::best_contrast_ink picks when the chosen background is light.

lang-accent.$description: The accent of the language being studied: :root[data-study=xx] points it at lang.accent.xx.

legacy-bg-default.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F5: the pre-hotfix Background default. Not painted: settings::load_prefs reads a stored copy as the default (#0A0A0B).

legacy-controls-default.$description: CC-ECLIPSE-HOTFIX F5: the pre-hotfix Controls default. Not painted: settings::load_prefs reads a stored copy as the default (neutral).

export-tier-dot-off.$description: Spell Picture share card: an unlit tier dot (spellpic_export.rs).

export-footer-bg.$description: Spell Picture share card footer band (spellpic_export.rs).

page-bg.$description: Yearbook and guardian report pages (PDF via SVG).

type.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F2 (A3): the three type roles and the per-script faces they hand over to.

display.$description: Headings, the brand, scores, the orb glyph.

ui.$description: Body text and chrome. Vietnamese overrides it (see $overrides): Instrument Sans has no Vietnamese subset.

answer.$description: The typed letters, the revealed spelling, the hint line.

arabic.$description: Arabic and Persian word surfaces (lazy, unicode-range gated).

urdu.$description: Urdu word surfaces. Urdu is not a registered language today.

vietnamese-ui.$description: The Bricolage files declared over the full weight axis, for Vietnamese body text.

zh.$description: Simplified Chinese system faces (iOS ships PingFang; zero payload). Behind visual.type.

ja.$value: 'Hiragino Sans','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Noto Sans JP'

tall.$description: Scripts with stacked marks or tall clusters (vi, hi, ar, fa, ur) on wrapping word surfaces. Behind visual.type.

motion.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE V-D9/V-D12 (A4): every duration in the app. Chrome transitions use the four-step duration scale; keyframe animations (anim.*) and mode-owned choreography (mode.<mode>.*) keep their exact pre-A4 timing under a name, because they are choreography owned by their features and their CC files, not generic UI motion.

instant.$description: State changes that should feel immediate (press, hover).

quick.$description: The default for UI state transitions.

base.$description: Larger surfaces: panels, the spellbox focus ring, fades.

slow.$description: Deliberate changes: the orb colour, overlays, progress fills.

i18n-cloak-delay.$description: Functional, not motion: how long the boot cloak waits before revealing untranslated text.

emit-stagger-1.$description: One third and two thirds of orb-emit, so the three rings leave evenly.

letter-lift.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F4: one letter's lift and settle on a correct answer.

letter-lift-stagger.$description: F4: the delay between neighbouring letters' lifts.

orb-fetch-grace.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F3: a clip that answers inside this never shows the orb's fetching inhale (no flicker).

orb-rest-after.$description: F3/V-D23: the idle breath pauses after this long without input.

orb-inhale.$description: F3: one fetching inhale, repeated while the clip is on its way.

letter-lift-budget.$description: F4: the latest any letter may start (300ms total minus letter-lift); long words compress the stagger to fit.

key-flight.$description: CC-SPELL-KEYBOARD KF5: a typed letter's ghost rises from its key into the answer (<= 120 ms).

key-wave.$description: KF7: one key's part in the correct-answer wave.

key-wave-step.$description: KF7: the wave's delay per ring out from the centre (whole reaction <= 500 ms).

key-dim.$description: KF7: the keys dim in caution amber on a wrong answer.

key-pulse.$description: KF7: the neutral 'submitted' pulse where a mode shows no verdict (K-D23).

constellation.$description: KF6: the constellation of a correct answer's keys lights, then fades (<= 1.2 s).

art-glint.$description: CC-THEMES-COSMOS T-D21: Diamond's one glint between words (at most 600 ms).

art-drift.$description: CC-THEMES-COSMOS F3: Aurora's ribbons drift between words only.

lang.$description: CC-VISUAL-ECLIPSE F10: one accent per study language (the "room" a language is). Used on the language chip, progress fills and a light orb tint; never as a verdict colour (ΔE2000 >= 20 from success and caution, result_card/themes tests) and never with a flag.

theme.$description: CC-THEMES-COSMOS F3: what an earned theme adds beyond colours. Every value is transparent or none outside the themes that use it, so Eclipse and the five Classic themes are unchanged (I-T7: a token change, never a layout change).

page-image.$description: The page's own ground (a metal sheen, a sky gradient), painted on the root under the art layer.

scrim.$description: T-D22: a darkening layer drawn above the art and below the UI (header band, orb ellipse, keyboard band). Only Diamond sets it.

hint-bg.$description: T-D22: a backing pill behind the hint line, drawn without padding (a box-shadow spread), so no box moves.

orb-art.$description: The orb's drawn face (a moon phase, a planet, a stone), set by src/theme_art.rs as a data URI; none keeps the gem.

keycap.$description: CC-SPELL-KEYBOARD F3 keycap tokens. That schema is absent (census C8), so these are defined but unused until it lands.

orb-label-bg.$description: A backing pill behind the orb's label where the orb wears a drawn face (a moon in shadow, a planet, a stone), so the label reads on any part of it. Transparent on the gem.

art.$description: CC-THEMES-COSMOS F3: the colours the drawn art uses (src/theme_art.rs). Art carries no meaning, so any hue is allowed (T-D18); text never sits on these without a scrim or a solid surface (I-T4).
